provenance.dataset: MGS MOLA DEM global mosaic 463 m (USGS Astrogeology, MOLA Team / GSFC)
provenance.processing: Reprojected to a site-centred azimuthal-equidistant grid at native resolution, area-averaged to exactly 463 m, then slope (central differences), RMS roughness (plane-detrended, ~1.4 km windows, median) and relief (max-min in 5 km windows, median).

acquired: not stated in the product label or USGS record
provenance.processing: Bilinear reprojection to a 1 km site grid, median of valid pixels.

provenance.dataset: Mars Odyssey THEMIS quantitative thermal inertia mosaic, USGS Astrogeology (Fergason et al. 2006, JGR 111:E12004; Edwards et al. 2011, JGR 116:E10009)
acquired: not stated per pixel; mosaic of THEMIS nighttime band 9 images
provenance.processing: Nearest-neighbour reprojection to a 100 m site grid, median of valid pixels (absolute accuracy ~20 %).

provenance.dataset: MRO CRISM map-projected targeted reduced data record (MTRDR), I/F corrected, PDS Geosciences Node
provenance.processing: Needed bands read by HTTP range from each I/F cube, nearest-neighbour reprojection to an 18 m site grid, observations mosaicked in product-ID order (first valid pixel wins); mean band depth over valid pixels (see metrics/mineralogy.py).
